body:
> We could also possibly inject the helper created by Vue InstantSearch into InstantSearch, so the reference is actually correct when calling init.

I feel like this makes more sense, than checking if helper has changed in IS.js.

If we bring a doubt to IS.js that helper may change, then it's going to be difficult to manage it in many places. Instead, it's Vue IS that changes the helper, we could inject that helper into IS.js and let IS.js be the same. What do you think?
